summary: Compute an anomaly (observed − climatological normal) and publish it as a new GeoZarr dataset

parameters.name: observed_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published observed collection (datetime time axis), e.g. era5land_temperature_daily.

parameters.name: normal_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published climatological normal (with a dayofyear or month ordinal axis).

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the anomaly dataset to publish. Must have a registered static dataset template on the instance (no ingestion plugin needed).

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable/band name carried through to the published anomaly dataset.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Observed time range as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings, e.g. ["2024-01-01", "2024-12-31"].
